In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''cantitruncated tesseractic honeycomb''' is a uniform  space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) in Euclidean 4-space.
